messages.author: 3a0f8d061378e811
messages.subject: Re: numericInput comma separator with jQuery
parts:
Hi Josh,

I'm sorry it took us so long to get back to you. Here is an app (you can find the full repo in my Github account) that gives you two options (and I think the second one is really what you want). The advantage to the first one is that you don't need any Javascript and you don't have to remember to coerce your value back into a comma-less numeric type. Please note that this is not really an "official" solution and you do lose some functionality, as explained in the app. We're hoping to actually give this option as an argument to the numericInput() function in the future. For now, though, I hope this helps!

Barbara
